svg.title: Complete six-transistor SRAM DC read-current testbench
svg.desc: Two cross-coupled CMOS inverters and two NMOS access transistors. Independent VDD and word-line voltage sources, two bit-line clamp sources and two ideal series ammeters. All ground symbols denote VSS. Internal storage nodes are not forced. MOS bulk connections are given in the notes.
svg.text: Complete transistor-level schematic • independent bit-line clamps • shared read word line
DC bias: VBL = VBLB = Vpre; VWL = VWL,read (nominally VDD).
Initialize Q = 0, QB = 1; reverse the data to read the other side. Q and QB remain unforced.
Bulk ties: all NMOS → VSS; both PMOS → VDD. A bridge at a wire crossing means no connection.
A = ideal series ammeter. Current is positive toward the cell; for Q = 0, Iread = I(BL).
